# the contributor audit: exact cap moments and an incomparable conserved mixture

Sources:
`candidate b6ffecfff4f39a35`
and `candidate 725f5c9c83566e55`.

exact moment, hinge, and stationary-row reconstruction verifier.

The tangent field xi_j(e_j-xi) has affine divergence 1-(d+1)xi_j.
It vanishes or is tangent on every original facet. Its outward flux
on the captured-side cut has sign minus and numerator c_j xi_j.
Thus the normalized moment identity is exactly
M_j=(P+L c_j b_j)/(d+1). Proper sections crossing original faces
cause no missing flux; the argument applies to d1 by interval calculus.
The Gamma radial decomposition of independent unit exponentials gives
L=d f_V(0), including its essential factor d. Summing the moment
formula divided by f_i under true raw-normal balance gives mass T and
uniform centroid T/(d+1). For positive stationary rows the proper
threshold equation is t_iL_i=dP_i, so t_i=P_i/f_i. Since each section
centroid is b, t_i=b.x_i; column sums then give sum t_i=1 and true
raw balance. The density normalization follows without replacing the
original simplex measure in any geometric conclusion.

The displayed three tetrahedral normals sum to zero and have the same
actual quadrilateral centroid. Direct cap triangulations give their
probabilities, exponential densities, and quadratic moments exactly.
Their normalized mixture decreases the convex test (xi_0-xi_1)^2 by
24871/106087500. On the support xi_0+xi_1>4/5, the first two caps
strictly hold and the third strictly fails; the mixture density is
950/943 there. Integrating the explicit Beta(2,2) density gives the
positive convex-hinge gap63/1178750. These two signs for the SAME
actual measure rule out convex order in both directions.

The reconstructed rows have every entry positive and each column sum1.
Their true cap thresholds obey the first-order minimizing equation.
Concavity of the cube root of captured volume makes its tangent an
upper bound; since the tangent passes through the origin, the displayed
threshold is a GLOBAL capacity-ratio minimum. The weighted gradients
agree with b, so the example is a true stationary family. It is not a
global maximizing family, and the audit does not promote it to one.

Thus actual sections, common centroid, raw-normal balance, and positive
stationary rows do not by themselves give a transport ordering. Any
such route must retain additional maximizing or incidence constraints.
